title: Colts GM Chris Ballard on Keenan Allen: Give him some grace

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Colts GM Chris Ballard on Keenan Allen: Give him some grace
sources.description: Wide receiver Keenan Allen remains a member of the Colts after being arrested for operating a vehicle while intoxicated over the weekend and it doesn't appear that's going to change in the coming days.
